capitalRisk.authority: User: any amount of risk if justified
capitalRisk.capitalAuthorization: User explicitly selected EGP 100,000 in Phase 3

sharedRisk.drawdownHandling: Advisory pause pending a newly justified Risk Agent exception; no automatic liquidation
sharedRisk.correlationHandling: Measured and stress-tested; advisory default sector cap, overrideable
sharedRisk.sizingBasis: Current verified paper equity and funded settled cash; no default growth or cut from recent wins/losses alone
sharedRisk.feeReserves: Entry costs and fixed exit-fee commitments must be funded; no negative cash

universe.discovery: Full reconciled EGX catalog, including recorded decisions absent from a scanner response
universe.trading: Verified tradable primary ordinary common equity, native EGP; exclude rights, funds, preferred, OTC, derivatives and unresolved special segments

indicators.atr: Wilder14 seeded by mean first14 of last260 true ranges, requiring261 closes
indicators.rv20: signal volume / mean prior20 complete session volumes

entry.signal: C >= nextValidTick(max prior20 highs), C>SMA50>SMA200, SMA50>SMA50[t-10], R63>0 and R63>=EGX30 R63, EGX30 C>SMA200
entry.window: First30 minutes of verified continuous session immediately following signal; approval and preflight committed before session open
entry.expiry: At first30-minute window end enter EXPIRED_PENDING_RECONCILIATION; eligible market-bar starts must remain inside window. Reconcile until window end + declared feed delay +6 minutes; retain cash reservations until resolution.
entry.reentry: New breakout signal after exit; no entry in a name already held or with pending entry
entry.sizingPrice: entry limit; lower fills cannot increase quantity

volume.tierDefinition: Sort eligible names by prior-session median turnover descending, tie ISIN; rank quantile ceil(3*rank/N), capped3
volume.quantile: nearest rank ceil(p*n), exclude signal day
volume.threshold: max(1.5, own-stock prior126 RV20 percentile for current liquidity tier)
volume.missing: BLOCK tier-aware variant, no automatic fallback

exit.initialStop: Frozen entry.stop; actual fill must exceed stop
exit.takeProfit: NONE; valuation scenario range is not an executable profit target
exit.trailing: After confirmed daily close >= actual entry + initial per-share price risk, latch active. Next session stop=max(previous stop,floorTick(highest completed daily close since entry - 2*current ATR)); never loosen.
exit.trendFailure: Confirmed daily close < SMA20 => exit intent for next continuous session
exit.timeExit: After close of20th session counting entry session as1, exit at next eligible continuous-session observation
exit.materialInvalidation: Source-backed thesis-break event independently recorded => cancel entries and exit intent at actual approval time; unavailable facts alone => risk alert, no fabricated liquidation
exit.weekEnd: No forced liquidation. End new entries after fifth entry session; manage existing positions and 5/20/60-session outcomes.
exit.riskLed: FULL discretionary variants only: earlier full exit with documented changed risk, alternatives and independent challenge. Never delay mandatory exit or widen stop; ordinary mandatory exits need no new risk approval.

fills.entryBar: Completed raw one-minute bar with start strictly later than order commit; in entry window, known session, not auction/halt/limit-locked; positive verified volume
fills.entryPrice: ceilTick(open*(1+adverseSlippage)); must lie inside zone, bar[low,high] and daily bands
fills.exitTriggerClock: Actual receipt/processing time of first completed bar showing stop breach; never backdate to historical bar end
fills.exitBar: Start strictly later than exit-intent commit; completed raw bar, legal/sellable shares, positive volume, 1% participation
fills.exitPrice: floorTick(open*(1-adverseSlippage)); must lie inside observed range and daily bands
fills.exitRetry: Next valid observed minute until filled; pending across sessions, flag unresolved risk
fills.sameBarAmbiguity: No entry and exit fill in same minute; entry-minute stop touch may trigger later exit only when observed
fills.missingMinute: No interpolation or assumed fill; retain open/pending status
fills.reconciliation: Evaluate authorization at market-bar start using actual committed validity/cancellation timeline; record market event and observation/ledger timestamps separately. After deadline, unresolved entries become NO_FILL_EVIDENCE, release reservation, censor outcome and fail coverage. Later observations are diagnostic only; no retrospective ledger fills. Exits remain pending.

settlement.saleCashReusable: After second subsequent verified settlement business day
settlement.boughtSharesSellable: After second subsequent verified settlement business day
settlement.unknownCalendar: BLOCK new entries and settle nothing by guess
settlement.note: A frozen simulation constraint, not certification of every account's MCDR/broker eligibility

analyticalGate.importantGaps: Default aggregate0.5 quantity haircut; Risk Agent may override for documented noncritical gaps with independent challenge, never reclassify critical gaps.
analyticalGate.sectorStrength: 20-session median peer return minus EGX30 return >=0 when >=5 peers and >=80% eligible sector coverage; negative blocks, unknown important gap
analyticalGate.peerComparison: >=5 comparable positive-denominator peers or explicit missing-important state; no automatic cheapness claim
analyticalGate.macro: Official event and company sensitivity review; no universal bullish FX/rate sign
analyticalGate.quality: Sector-specific solvency and accounting reconciliation; material contradictory evidence blocks
analyticalGate.probabilities: Only with justified precommitted model; otherwise uncertain
analyticalGate.reviewExpiry: Each next-session setup; material event invalidates immediately

schedule.monitorEnd: Verified close +actual delay +5min; then final daily capture

ranking.discovery: Descending R63-EGX30 R63, descending medianTurnover20, ascending ISIN
ranking.allocation: Default deterministic rank; Risk Agent may choose another eligible candidate or smaller/no allocation with documented portfolio comparison; shared cash reserved atomically.

variants.kind: Technical only; bounded control risk; mandatory integrity/legal/cost/risk gates remain
B3 + tier-aware RV; hard1%/4%/25%/40%/10%/6 risk control
Same eligibility as FULL-BOUNDED; discretionary Risk Agent funded-cash allocation; declared champion
FULL without peer context/gap haircut; critical financial checks remain
FULL without macro overlay; material-event safety checks remain
FULL without sector-strength eligibility gate; concentration analysis retained

riskGovernance.riskAgentRequired: Only discretionary FULL variants; bounded controls use deterministic validation, not invented Risk Agent certificates
hard: no borrowing, leverage, shorting, pyramiding or averaging down
funded settled cash and modeled fee reserves
critical data, identity, chronology and market rules
required approvals, independent challenge and audit trail
new-entry expiry and five-session entry window
riskGovernance.overrideProcedure: Enumerated exception, evidence, alternatives, adverse scenarios, default/proposed portfolio arithmetic, independent challenge and deterministic checks; one snapshot/order only; expire/revoke on changes; no retrospective approval

drawdownReview.unknownMarks: Block new allocations; never infer no breach

riskGovernance.sizingOutput: Deterministic artifact; model-selected monetary budget, never model-edited share count

budgets.maxPlannedLossEGP: Nullable positive entry planned-loss ceiling chosen by Risk Agent
budgets.maxCashAllocationEGP: Nullable positive cash allocation including entry costs and fixed exit-fee reserves
budgets.requirement: At least one positive for approved entry; both constrain when provided

riskGovernance.certificateLifecycle: Bind pre-reservation snapshot and order intent; atomic accepted-order receipt links expected reservation. Own reservation does not invalidate approval. Nonmaterial changes require deterministic revalidation; quantity cannot increase. Material changes cancel at actual committed time; no retroactive cancellation of earlier authorized market events.
